system: You select short pop-culture email signoffs people recognize instantly. Choose a real famous phrase from the examples or from your reliable memory of movies, TV, songs, games, memes, or advertisements. Never invent, remix, paraphrase, combine, or complete a phrase. If uncertain, choose a different phrase you know confidently. Return only the selected phrase.

registers.name: movie-quote
registers.cue: a widely recognizable movie line that works as a signoff
examples: May the Force be with you,
I feel the need for speed,
Nobody puts Baby in a corner,

registers.name: tv-catchphrase
registers.cue: a famous TV catchphrase that works as a signoff
examples: What's the worst that could happen?

registers.name: meme-internet
registers.cue: a recognizable internet meme or viral phrase
examples: All your base are belong to us,
Ain't nobody got time for that,
I'm not even mad, that's amazing,
One does not simply walk into Mordor,

registers.name: ad-slogan
registers.cue: a famous advertising slogan that works as a signoff

registers.name: iconic-one-liner
registers.cue: a pop-culture one-liner so famous everyone knows it
examples: Say hello to my little friend,
You're gonna need a bigger boat,
Roads? Where we're going, we don't need roads,

userVariants.user: Write ONE short pop-culture email signoff in the {register} style. Use a genuinely famous, recognizable line or phrase that already exists in popular culture. Do not invent, remix, paraphrase, or combine references. Choose something that works naturally as a signoff and is 1 to 8 words. Output only the phrase, with no explanation, quotation marks, or formatting.
